Good to Know
How do I get there?

The venue is in Haldighati, about an hour's drive from Udaipur city. Approximate road distances:

  • Udaipur Airport (Maharana Pratap, UDR): about 55–58 km, 1 to 1.5 hours
  • Udaipur City Railway Station: about 38–45 km, around 1 hour
  • Udaipur city bus stand: about 40–45 km, around 1 hour

Times vary with traffic. Please share your arrival details in the RSVP form.

What will the weather be like?

February in Udaipur has pleasant days and cool evenings. Carry a light jacket or shawl for the night functions.

What should I know about the ceremony?

The Anand Karaj takes place at the venue in the presence of Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Everyone covers their head and wears traditional attire. Please do not wear red to the ceremony. Please keep alcohol and tobacco away from the ceremony space.

Can I bring family or a guest?

List everyone who is attending in the RSVP form, so we can plan seats and rooms for each person.
